summary: Add a local, read-only report of native person asks by mission × person over a rolling 7 days; not fleet-complete.

replay.detail: Uses the existing canonical request and run-lineage claims.

schema.detail: No durable claim or table changes.

rules.detail: This report is not a budget window, admission or enforcement. No changes to attention delivery, approvals or work admission.

compatibility.detail: Adds the public Rust Store::attention_request_count method and AttentionRequestCount type; no CLI, HTTP or wire API changes.
